title: Persist browser workbench state in the remote Code server
reason: OpenVSCode's browser workbench stores notification filters, dismissal flags, first-run state, and workspace UI state in browser IndexedDB. Cantrip embeds and reconnects that workbench across replaceable webviews, so the state must live in the worker-owned Code profile; extensions cannot replace the workbench storage service or expose a server storage channel.
validation: Restart a Cantrip Code session and confirm notification filters and never-show choices remain applied
removal: Remove after upstream OpenVSCode offers a supported worker-backed browser storage service with durable profile and workspace state.
